metadata.fit_cost_scope: One diagnostic variant: feature assembly, source weighting, development-only standardization and ridge fitting. Forecasting/probe data acquisition costs belong to the recorded task nodes; no amortization assumed.

metadata_geometry.fit_cost_scope: One diagnostic variant: feature assembly, source weighting, development-only standardization and ridge fitting. Forecasting/probe data acquisition costs belong to the recorded task nodes; no amortization assumed.

metadata_probe.fit_cost_scope: One diagnostic variant: feature assembly, source weighting, development-only standardization and ridge fitting. Forecasting/probe data acquisition costs belong to the recorded task nodes; no amortization assumed.

metadata_probe_geometry.fit_cost_scope: One diagnostic variant: feature assembly, source weighting, development-only standardization and ridge fitting. Forecasting/probe data acquisition costs belong to the recorded task nodes; no amortization assumed.

offline_fit_cost_scope: One-off fitting of all four predeclared variants from the saved development records; no assumed deployment-count amortization. Per-task feature, probe, forecasting and scalar inference costs are reported in policy outcomes. Freeze serialization and hashing are excluded from model fitting time.
scope: Internal freeze after development and before reserved-family confirmation; no external timestamp attestation. All four fixed models are retained.

spec.costs: Sum unique declared required cost nodes; validation selectors pay all searched candidates but refit/forecast only the chosen one; learned/probe selectors pay their diagnostic/probe nodes even when KAHM is rejected.
spec.decision: Choose KAHM only when predicted log benefit is strictly positive; raw on ties.
spec.feature_standardization: Weighted development mean and population standard deviation, learned within each source-family fold; constant scale replaced by one.
spec.inference: Descriptive family-level outcomes, between-family dispersion and leave-one-family-out sensitivity only; no population coverage or significance claim.
spec.secondary_benefit: At least the fixed practical relative MSE reduction, with the declared loss floor near zero.
spec.selection: All four predeclared diagnostic models are frozen and reported. No best diagnostic is selected using confirmation outcomes.
spec.weights: Equal source-family weight, then equal weight at every nested level; no duplicated task keys.
